description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the sizes of method pointers in classes with different inheritance types, including multiple and virtual inheritance, specifically on MSVC compilers. It also tests handling of method pointers for incomplete classes within the Abseil synchronization library.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: A class with a boolean state and a method that toggles it.

classes.name: M2
classes.description: A class with a boolean state and a method that toggles it.

classes.name: MultipleInheritance
classes.description: A class inheriting from Callback and M2 to test multiple inheritance method pointers.

classes.name: VirtualInheritance
classes.description: A class with virtual inheritance from Callback to test virtual inheritance method pointers.

classes.name: IncompleteClass
classes.description: Forward-declared class used to test method pointer size for incomplete classes.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Toggles and returns the boolean state in Callback.

methods.name: method2
methods.description: Toggles and returns the boolean state in M2.

methods.name: MutexMethodPointerTest.MicrosoftMethodPointerSize
methods.description: Verifies the size of method pointers for classes with different inheritance types on MSVC.

methods.name: ConditionWithMultipleInheritanceMethod
methods.description: Tests that absl::Condition can handle method pointers from classes with multiple inheritance.

methods.name: ConditionWithVirtualInheritanceMethod
methods.description: Tests that absl::Condition can handle method pointers from classes with virtual inheritance.

methods.name: ConditionWithIncompleteClassMethod
methods.description: Tests size constraints of method pointers for incomplete classes.
